Why do stores pay more to take an Amex card?
In 2025, merchants paid American Express $37.4 billion in discount revenue, about half of its $72.2 billion total revenue and more than double its $17.4 billion in net interest income.
Unlike Visa and Mastercard, where banks issue the cards, Amex issues its own cards, runs the network and signs up merchants: a closed loop.
Amex cardmembers spent $25,453 per card on average in 2025.
Sources: American Express FY2025 10-K and Q4 2025 earnings release.
News and education, not financial advice.
